title: dotw:search Response
description: Success response from dotw:search --json. Lists available hotels for the given city and dates.

hotels.description: List of available hotels. Use hotel_id with dotw:rooms:browse or dotw:prebook.

hotel_id.description: DOTW hotel ID. Pass to dotw:prebook as first argument.

hotel_name.description: Hotel name (empty in search RS; populated in dotw:hotels:show).

min_fare.description: Lowest available rate across all room types. Currency from profile.

rate_basis.description: Rate basis name for the cheapest rate (e.g. Room Only, Breakfast).

thumbnail.description: Hotel image URL (if available from DOTW).
